question: How many Rasas are presented in classical dances?
solution:
The correct answer is __**9**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Nine Rasas(Navarasa):

 
• The Navarasa, in India’s traditional arts and literature, refers to the nine expressions or human emotions that humans show. 
 
• These are the nine emotions that are known to evoke an audience during an experience of a dance, music, or drama performance according to the Natyashastra.
 
• The nine rasas are:
 
 
• Shringaara(Love)
 
• Roudra (Anger)
 
• Bibhitsa (Disgust) *Hence, Option 3 is correct.*
 
• Veera (Heroism)
 
• Shaant (Peace & Tranquility)
 
• Hasya (Laughter & Comedy)
 
• Karuna(Tragedy)
 
• Bhayanak (Horror)
 
• Adbhuta (Wonder)
 
 
 
• Just as life without rasas is incomplete, literature or film without rasas in proper proportion is deficient.
